content: Over-engineering risks for a 30+ homework monorepo: custom build orchestration (Nx/Bazel/Turborepo), per-project containers, premature universal abstractions, speculative scaffolding, a bespoke docs platform, mandatory HIL for every assignment, grade tracking, and PDF/DOCX pipelines. Monorepo experience reports emphasize that shared tooling only pays when coupling and scale justify it; personal monorepos work when the tooling stays boring and the shared conventions are real. Prefer one documented entry point, generated artifacts with drift checks, and defer infrastructure until a second consumer exists.
